hiringProcess.title: Apply
hiringProcess.body: Tell us about yourself and share your CV. It takes a few minutes and needs no account.

hiringProcess.title: Review
hiringProcess.body: Someone on the team reads your application against what the role needs.

hiringProcess.title: Conversation
hiringProcess.body: Selected candidates speak with the team about the work and ask their own questions.

hiringProcess.title: Assessment
hiringProcess.body: Some roles include a short practical task drawn from the real work. The role page says so if it does.

hiringProcess.title: Decision
hiringProcess.body: If you reach the conversation stage, we let you know the outcome by email, whichever way it goes.
